[[File:Tele Group Waterbirth icon (mobile).png|left|class=pageimage]]
'''Tele Group Waterbirth''' teleports the player along with anyone within a 3x3 square area (including standing on the player's square) beside Jarvald's ship on [[Waterbirth Island]]. Players must have Accept Aid turned on in order to be teleported by this spell; otherwise they will be left behind when the caster teleports. A window will pop for the person being teleported asking them if they wished to be teleported. As with all [[Lunar spells]], the quest [[Lunar Diplomacy]] must be completed to cast this spell.
